label: Rival: some composite has no cause of its being at all (brute or necessary composition)
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed, motivated by brute composition and by accounts of a composite necessary being whose distinct members cannot come apart: some composite has no cause of its being, itself included. The replacement account is that its members cohere of themselves, by necessity or as a brute fact. Strictly stronger than the negation of STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-A-UNITING-CAUSE, which would allow a composite whose only cause of being is itself. It does not say that no composite has a cause.
